description: Fear is organized around enemies and used to justify coercive authority.
Collapse narratives intensify dread while agency and trust collapse.
Continuous crisis messaging weakens agency participation and public trust.
Optimism is used as branding while accountability and structural change remain weak.
Technology promises calm publics while climate governance and repair are deferred.
Youth participation connects intergenerational emotion with public action.
Risk is named honestly while action pathways institutions and repair remain visible.
Future possibility is linked to repair memory ecological care and redistributed authority.
